checks.description: The static catalogue preserves all 31 original IDs, publication URLs, availability and the separation of full-media duration from local preview intervals.
Every editorial series starts without media; choosing the Baki 60 cm publication remains an explicit visual reference in the Sculpture XL 1 m dossier.
Saved versions are append-only, keep historical dossier names and export their explicit target after another dossier becomes active; quote, story and project revision remain intact.
Two windows editing the same first revision converge to one saved version; the conflicting operation remains auditable and no existing plan is erased.
Two complete plan versions and their source identities survive browser backup, reopened SQLite and additive restoration alongside an unrelated local story.
The project Studio route opens on the explicit XL dossier without associating a publication or announcing a rendered project film.
Choosing a real archive preview and editing its original interval keeps the creative brief and caption untouched; source relation remains an explicit reference.
After another screen selects Prototype, the unchanged form saves to its original XL dossier and all three screens keep their display roles.
A competing saved revision preserves the local unsaved text, blocks exporting that draft and refuses an obsolete save without overwriting the retained history.
An old saved version is read-only and exports unchanged; explicit resume creates revision 3 from it while preserving both preceding versions.
Opening another panel disposes the project Studio so retained DOM cannot save/export again; plan work invokes no API write, render, cloud or social publication.
An offline journal merge that changes the winning content of revision 1 cannot silently export or save the formerly displayed revision; explicit rebase preserves the draft and produces revision 2.
Save and export reject a changed base operation even before its storage notification reaches the form, preserving its text and exposing the updated conflict for explicit rebase.

scope: Real app, project Studio, business model, backup validator and SQLite repository in isolated fixtures; no browser engine, preview server, renderer or external service.
